title: Rite Aid Christmas Train Waterglobe Santa Reindeer Snow Globe 2009 Glitter
descriptionText:
Christmas train waterglobe - a glitter snow globe with Santa, a reindeer and a decorated Christmas tree inside the glass globe, mounted on a red wreath-trimmed train car pulled by a blue-and-green locomotive. Resin base, glass globe. Rite Aid holiday item #9006059-MMIX (2009), original $19.99 price tag still on the underside. About 6 inches long, 5 inches tall. Not a music box - decorative only.

Condition: Pre-owned, displays nicely. Water is clear with glitter snow; light shelf wear to the paint on the base and wheels. Please review all photos - they are of the actual item you will receive.
